subject: se
question: Name any three UML diagrams used to represent the behavioural view of a system. Briefly explain the purpose of each.
title: Floor Plan vs Life
hook: A floor plan shows what exists. It cannot show who walks in, who talks, what happens next. That is behaviour.
answer: Behavioural diagrams show what the system DOES (structural diagrams show what it is made of).
Use case diagram: actors and the functions (use cases) they use. Purpose: capture what users want from the system.
Sequence diagram: messages between objects in time order. Purpose: show how objects collaborate in one scenario.
Activity diagram: a flowchart of steps, decisions, start and end. Purpose: model the workflow step by step.
Memory trick: use case = WHO, sequence = WHEN, activity = HOW.
